description: Track milestone progress with associated issues and MRs. Actions: list (filter by state/title/search), get (milestone details), issues (items in milestone), merge_requests (MRs targeting milestone), burndown (chart data for sprint tracking). Related: manage_milestone to create/update.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get, issues, merge_requests, burndown

iids.description: Return only the milestones having the given iid Required for 'list' action(s).

include_ancestors.description: Include ancestor groups Required for 'list' action(s).

milestone_id.description: The ID of a project or group milestone. Required for 'get', 'issues', 'merge_requests', 'burndown' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list', 'issues', 'merge_requests', 'burndown' action(s).

search.description: Return only milestones with a title or description matching the provided string Required for 'list' action(s).

state.description: Return only active or closed milestones Required for 'list' action(s).

title.description: Return only milestones with a title matching the provided string Required for 'list' action(s).

updated_after.description: Return milestones updated after the specified date (ISO 8601 format) Required for 'list' action(s).

updated_before.description: Return milestones updated before the specified date (ISO 8601 format) Required for 'list' action(s).

name: browse_milestones
